_readme: Flipline: plans sold, Pro sheet words, Free/Pro caps and the ad switch. The app re-reads this file every 6 hours; no app update needed. plans: monthly and/or yearly (the Play products must exist). headline/bullets: blank = the app's own words. freeLimits: comps (1-20), ownFeeds (1-50), historyDays (7-90). proLimits: ownFeeds (free-500), historyDays (free-365). A number left out uses the app's built-in one. ads: admobLive true + a real androidBanner unit id = Google banners for Free users; false = our own offers only. ebay: live true + proxyUrl (our eBay server, https) = Play users get eBay values through the server; soldsLive adds eBay sold prices once eBay grants Marketplace Insights. Off until eBay approves (server/README.md in the Flipline repo).
